nav.label: Site
crowding.h1: Evacuation shelters: open status and crowding
crowding.officialBtn: Open the open-status / crowding map (Fujisawa City, official)
crowding.officialBody: Under an agreement with VACAN Inc., Fujisawa City publishes a map showing whether evacuation sites are open and how crowded they are ("available", "somewhat crowded", "crowded", "closed"). The button above opens the city's guide page, from which you can go to the map (VACAN Maps; Japanese).
crowding.bosaiNavi: Fujisawa Bousai Navi (disaster information; also reachable via "Evacuation information" → "Evacuation sites")
crowding.designatedTitle: "Find an evacuation site" on this website lists designated facilities.
crowding.designatedBody: It does not show whether they are open or crowded. Always check the official information above.
crowding.userWarnTitle: These are "reports from users" that anyone can send without logging in.
crowding.userWarnBody: They are not the city's official open status or capacity. They may include mistakes or false reports.
crowding.reportNote: Only the facility and the crowding level are sent. No name, email address or location is sent.
footer.sources: Sources, data handling and update status
footer.unofficial: Fujisawa Lens is an unofficial website. It is not operated by Fujisawa City, Kanagawa Prefecture or the national government, and it does not replace official announcements.

home.disclaimer: This website does not replace official announcements. Follow evacuation instructions and the situation around you. Storm-surge sites, tsunami evacuation buildings and welfare shelters cannot be searched on this website.

home.prepareLead: Use the checklist to check water and food, lights, power, how to contact family, evacuation sites and more. Your progress is saved only on this device.
offline.body: This page has not been saved on this device, so it cannot be shown.
offline.sheltersNote: (works with saved data if you have opened it before)
offline.warn: Because you are offline, you cannot check the latest evacuation instructions, warnings or shelter open status. Check official information once you are back online.
prepare.lead: Based on the "Disaster preparedness checklist" by the Prime Minister's Office and Cabinet Office, and information from Fujisawa City and the Japan Meteorological Agency. Your checks are saved only in this device's browser and are never sent anywhere.
prepare.amountNote: Amounts (such as 3 liters of drinking water per person per day for 3 days) are guidelines from the sources. Adjust them to your family size, medical needs, etc.
shelters.alert: If danger is close, move to a nearby safe place (such as an upper floor of a sturdy building).
shelters.pickHint: Tap a button to immediately list sites nearest to your current location. Your location is used only to calculate distances on this device and is never sent.
shelters.manualSummary: Search without location (district, facility name, address)
shelters.query: Filter by facility name or address (in Japanese)

shelters.diffSummary: "Designated Emergency Evacuation Site" vs. "Designated Evacuation Shelter"
shelters.diffEmergency: Designated Emergency Evacuation Site: a place to flee to urgently to protect your life from a disaster. Sites are designated for each type of disaster. Do not go to a site that is not designated for the disaster you are facing.
shelters.diffShelter: Designated Evacuation Shelter: a facility to stay in until the danger has passed or when you cannot return home. Its role is different from a place to flee to in an emergency.
shelters.mapSummary: Distance, Google Maps and data sources
shelters.mapDistance: Distances are straight-line distances. They do not show walking distance, travel time or whether roads are passable.
shelters.mapGoogle: "Route" and "Map" open Google Maps (app or website), an external service. This website does not send your location, but Google Maps uses your device's location as the starting point for routes. Routes may not be passable during a disaster.
shelters.queryPlaceholder: e.g. 辻堂, 鵠沼海岸 (Japanese)

shelters.sourceNote1: The official update date for each facility is not included in the data, so it is shown as "Unknown". Coordinates are from the GSI data and may not show the exact location of the site or building.
shelters.sourceNote2: Each disaster type is checked against the Fujisawa City list, and types whose designation cannot be confirmed in the city list are not shown in results.

pre.tsunamiTitle: Tsunami: when you feel shaking, go to the highest place you can, right away.
pre.tsunamiBody: In coastal areas, tsunami evacuation buildings are also evacuation sites (they are not included in this website's data).
pre.designatedTitle: This is a list of designated facilities; whether they are open is unknown.
pre.cityOnlyTitle: Facilities to check in the official list:
pre.cityOnlyBody: The Fujisawa City list designates these for this disaster, but this website's data (GSI) cannot confirm it, so they are not in the list above.
pre.cityOnlyLink: Check the Fujisawa City list of evacuation sites
pre.inland: Designations for inland flooding (flooding when sewers and waterways overflow in heavy rain) come from the GSI data. The Fujisawa City list has no column for inland flooding, so they were not checked against it.
pre.routeNote: Routes are provided by Google Maps and may not be passable during a disaster.
shelters.straightNote: Distances are straight-line (walking distance, travel time and whether roads are passable are unknown).
shelters.none: No officially designated sites match these conditions. This website does not suggest other types of facilities instead.

checklist.section.stock: Water and food stock (for each family member)

checklist.item.rolling: I buy extra long-life food and replace it as I use it

checklist.item.daily-goods: Daily goods (toilet paper, tissues, plastic wrap, garbage bags, water tank)
checklist.detail.flashlight: A hand-crank rechargeable one is useful
checklist.detail.radio: A hand-crank rechargeable one is useful

checklist.item.bag-pack: I have packed things to take in a backpack
checklist.detail.valuables: Bankbook, cash, passport, driver's license, hospital card, My Number card, etc.
checklist.item.clothes: Clothes and underwear, rainwear, slip-on shoes
checklist.detail.firstaid: Bandages, adhesive plasters, disinfectant, regular medicines, etc.

checklist.item.furniture: Furniture is fixed to the wall

checklist.link.evac-by-type: Find evacuation sites on this website

checklist.item.tsunami-zone: I checked on the tsunami hazard map whether my home etc. is in an area expected to flood
checklist.item.tsunami-bldg: I checked the nearest tsunami evacuation building and the route to it
checklist.item.tsunami-map: I checked the tsunami evacuation map for my area

checklist.item.flood-evac: I checked the emergency evacuation sites for floods and landslides
checklist.item.surge-map: I checked the risks to my home etc. on the storm-surge hazard map

checklist.item.child-care: Children's diapers, wipes, portable bottom washer
checklist.item.child-other: Portable cutlery, neck light, baby carrier, children's shoes
